1. Governments can review the privacy act to ensure it is suitable for the context of more personal information being captured and processed, empowering consumers to protect their data. Countries cited for this approach include Australia, France, USA, UK, and the Netherlands.

2. Governments can explore privacy-enhancing technologies that can remove barriers to data sharing by managing risks from sharing commercially sensitive and personal data. Countries cited for this approach include Australia, France, and the USA.
